$comment: The shop's starting set-up for a FRESHLY MIGRATED production database, applied once by
Only what the migrations do not already give: the address, phone, hours, delivery prices,
reviews and repair-text wording come with the migrations. Products, devices and their repair
prices are entered in the admin panel from the client's own lists. Edit this file, not the
database, until the day it is applied; after that the admin panel is the place.

categories.$comment: Non-protected categories not listed here are removed (the migrations seed Audio, Mounts, Power, Protection). Mobiles, Number Plates and Vape are protected and always stay.

repairTypes.$comment: Added beside the migrations' own 'Something else'. subTypes: the standard part grades (original, oem, copy) a priced repair is offered in; a diagnosis-only repair has none.

list.name: Battery replacement
list.description: Won't hold charge, or drains fast.

devices.$comment: Only the catch-all. The repair and sell flows offer 'Other / not listed' (brand other) for a phone that isn't on the list, and ask the customer what it is; every real model and its prices are added in Admin > Device Models. On an unknown phone only the free diagnoses are offered (price 0) — a priced repair can't be quoted for a model nobody has named. Prices are pence; subType null for a diagnosis.

owner.$comment: Created with a one-time temporary password, printed once by the script. Every other member of staff is added by the owner in Admin > Staff.
owner.name: jaspreet
